definitions.gloss: clearance item; markdown item; discount merchandise
definitions.explanation: Products sold at reduced prices because they are nearing expiration, slightly damaged, or the store wants to clear inventory.

examples.japanese: {見切|みき}り{品|ひん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought it from the clearance section.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{半額|はんがく}→半額：09546_hangaku⟧だった。
examples.english: These vegetables were half price as clearance items.

examples.japanese: {閉店前|へいてんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{見切|みき}り{品|ひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go shopping before closing time to get clearance items.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{見切|みき}り→見切る：27209_mikiru⟧ (giving up on, writing off) + ⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (item) - items the store has given up on selling at full price.

USAGE:
Common at:
- Supermarkets (near-expiry food)
- Department stores (seasonal items)
- Electronics stores (older models)
- {見切|みき}り{品|ひん}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧ - clearance section
- {見切|みき}り{品|ひん}⟦セール→セール：07780_seeru⟧ - clearance sale

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{値引|ねび}き→値引き：05424_nebiki⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ - discounted items
- {処分品|しょぶんひん} - items for disposal/clearance
